_comment: Tracked placeholder art (Ojon 2026-11-23, issue #28 Chapter 2). Every stand-in in the game is listed here: it reuses existing art, recoloured by tools/make_placeholders.py, at the exact path and id the final art will use, so the swap is dropping the new file in (no code or data change) and deleting its entry here. tests/test_placeholders.gd prints this list on every test run and checks each entry; the release check (tools/release_check.sh, issue #118) fails while any entry remains. The GitHub issue 'Chapter 2 art swap' tracks the same list. Fields: id (<kind>:<name>, the name is the art id), kind (sprite, portrait, prop, tiles, icon, music, cg), path (repo path the final art goes to; a folder for sprite sets and ground sets), from (the existing art it is recoloured from; empty for cg: the scene plays without one), recolor (steps, see tools/make_placeholders.py), variants (props: how many _v<n> variants to copy too), for (where the game uses it), final (the brief for the paid art batch; style rules in docs/ART_STYLE.md, sizes match the stand-in unless it says otherwise).

placeholders.for: Eraser Reader, Chapter 2 enemy (data/enemies.json reader)
placeholders.final: Verity's follower: a former Concord archivist in a long whitewashed coat, ledger strapped to the chest, a short burning taper as a blade. 44px canvas, same anims as the sellsword (rot, idle, walk, attack 6, hurt). Attack: a lunge with the taper.

placeholders.for: Eraser Whitewasher, Chapter 2 ranged enemy (data/enemies.json whitewasher, spitter behaviour)
placeholders.final: An Eraser with a bucket and a long brush, apron splashed white. 44px canvas: rot, idle, walk, attack 8 (dips the brush, swells back, flings a glob of whitewash), hurt.

placeholders.for: Blotted Penitent, Chapter 2 Blank enemy (data/enemies.json penitent)
placeholders.final: A monk the Blank half-ate: brown habit, hood, the face and hands gone white and blank, shuffling with a scourge. 44px canvas: rot, idle, walk, attack 6 (scourge swing), hurt.

placeholders.for: Copyist, Chapter 2 Blank enemy that draws erasing lines (scripts/copyist.gd)
placeholders.final: A kneeling scribe-monk with a quill as long as an arm and a lap desk, ink running white. 44px canvas: rot, idle, walk, plus a 'cast' (6 frames: raises the quill and draws a line across the floor) and hurt.

placeholders.for: The Abbot Who Copied Himself, Chapter 2 boss and his copies (scripts/abbot.gd)
placeholders.final: Abbot Wulfstan: tall, gaunt, crimson and gold vestments, a crozier topped with an inkwell, a mitre of stacked pages. 88px canvas like the Auditor: rot, idle, walk, attack 8 (crozier sweep), sweep 8 (writes a line in the air), hurt, phase 8 (splits into copies), death 8 (pages blow apart).

placeholders.for: Sister Osyth, Chapter 2 story recruit (crypt-keeper), town post and escort in the crypts
placeholders.final: Sister Osyth: small, sixties, dark grey habit gone green at the hem from the crypts, a tally-board of notched wood on a cord, a lantern. 44px canvas: rot, idle, walk.

placeholders.for: Brother Cuthbert, Chapter 2 light recruit (bell-ringer)
placeholders.final: Brother Cuthbert: broad, deaf, rope-burned hands, brown habit with the sleeves tied back, a bell-rope over one shoulder. 44px canvas: rot, idle.

placeholders.for: Nell Tapper, Chapter 2 light recruit (Candleford chandler)
placeholders.final: Nell Tapper: forties, leather apron spattered with wax, a rack of dipped candles on her back, burn-scarred forearms. 44px canvas: rot, idle.

placeholders.for: Brother Alcuin, Chapter 2 light recruit (Eraser defector)
placeholders.final: Brother Alcuin: young, thin, an Eraser's white coat worn over a monk's habit, the coat's sleeve torn off where the Reader's badge was. 44px canvas: rot, idle.
